summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing exhibits (consents and jurisdictional forms) related to its final short form base shelf prospectus filed on SEDAR+. The filing is purely procedural — registering up to $500M in securities (common shares, debt, warrants, etc.) for future offering. No specific acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or special situation event is disclosed. The 6-K serves only to provide expert consents and non-issuer submissions to jurisdiction, routine for shelf prospectus filings. There is no deal terms, premium, or structural mechanics to analyze.
